    word_token_indices = case['word_token_indices']
    word_scores = case['word_scores']
    forced_words = case['forced_words']
    token_budget = case['token_budget']
    n = len(word_token_indices)
    weights = [len(toks) for toks in word_token_indices]
    forced_set = set(forced_words)
    forced_weight = sum(weights[i] for i in forced_set)
    forced_value = sum(word_scores[i] for i in forced_set)
    optional_indices = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
    best_value = float('-inf')
    best_subset = None
    m = len(optional_indices)
    for mask in range(1 << m):
        subset = []
        weight = forced_weight
        value = forced_value
        for j in range(m):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                idx = optional_indices[j]
                subset.append(idx)
                weight += weights[idx]
                value += word_scores[idx]
        if weight <= token_budget:
            if value > best_value:
                best_value = value
                best_subset = subset
    if best_subset is None:
        best_subset = []
    selected_words = sorted(list(forced_set) + best_subset)
    retained_token_indices = []
    for wi in selected_words:
        retained_token_indices.extend(word_token_indices[wi])
    tokens_used = sum(weights[wi] for wi in selected_words)
    return {
        'retained_token_indices': retained_token_indices,
        'selected_words': selected_words,
        'tokens_used': tokens_used
    }"
}

    n = len(word_token_indices)
    weights = [len(toks) for toks in word_token_indices]
    forced_set = set(forced_words)
    forced_weight = sum(weights[i] for i in forced_set)
    forced_value = sum(word_scores[i] for i in forced_set)
    optional_indices = [i for i in range(n) if i not in forced_set]
    best_value = float('-inf')
    best_subset = None
    # enumerate subsets of optional_indices
    m = len(optional_indices)
    for mask in range(1 << m):
        subset = []
        weight = forced_weight
        value = forced_value
        for j in range(m):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                idx = optional_indices[j]
                subset.append(idx)
                weight += weights[idx]
                value += word_scores[idx]
        if weight <= token_budget:
            if value > best_value:
                best_value = value
                best_subset = subset
    # if no feasible subset (e.g., forced alone exceeds budget), we still select forced
    if best_subset is None:

    selected_words = sorted(list(forced_set) + best_subset)
    retained_token_indices = []
    for wi in selected_words:
        retained_token_indices.extend(word_token_indices[wi])
    tokens_used = sum(weights[wi] for wi in selected_words)
    return {
        'retained_token_indices': retained_token_indices,
        'selected_words': selected_words,
        'tokens_used': tokens_used
    }
